whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Your Site Shouldn't Be Left Unmaintained
whatIs.paragraph1: Your website is live — but then what? Updates not being applied, backups not being taken, security vulnerabilities not being patched?
whatIs.paragraph2: An unmaintained website is like an unmaintained vehicle — it breaks down eventually, and usually at the worst possible time. When a site goes down, business loss and reputational damage are inevitable.
whatIs.paragraph3: At Sybor Digital, we ensure your site runs healthy 24/7 with regular maintenance, proactive security and fast technical support.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: When can we start?
delivery.answer: We typically begin active maintenance within 3-5 days after the site audit.

pricing.question: How much does monthly maintenance cost?
pricing.answer: Varies by site size, technology and support level. Fixed monthly packages are available.

revisions.question: Are small content changes included?
revisions.answer: A certain number of content changes per month are included depending on the package.

maintenance.question: How quickly will you respond if my site goes down?
maintenance.answer: 1-hour guaranteed response during business hours. 4-hour guaranteed response for critical e-commerce sites.

migration.question: Can you maintain a site built by another agency?
migration.answer: Yes. We first audit the site, learn the structure and then take over maintenance.

mobile.question: Where are backups stored?
mobile.answer: Backups are stored in the cloud across multiple geographic locations. Your data is always safe.
